scope: streptavidin-agarose beads (50% slurry in wash buffer) were added to each sample (40 μL/sample) and the bead mixture was rotated for 2 h at rt.

the beads were pelleted by centrifugation (2,000 g, 1 min), transferred to a BioSpin column and washed (3 × 1 mL wash buffer, 3 × 1 mL PBS, 3 × 1 mL H2O). Peptides were eluted by the addition of 300 μL of 50% aqueous CH3CN containing 0.1% FA.

streptavidin-agarose beads were added for the enrichment (final SDS concentration: 0.2% in PBS). The beads (100 μL of a 50% slurry per sample) were washed with PBS (2 × 10 mL) and resuspended in 1 mL of PBS per sample prior to addition.

Following the precedence rules, the affinity-purified material overrides the whole cell lysate label.
